name: Blessed Water
description: Water sanctified in a formal rite for warding and minor purification.
effects: Supports consecration, ward tracing, or cleansing narration against minor corruption.

name: Holy Water
description: A potent consecrated vial reserved for grave rites and hostile profane entities.
effects: Supports strong purification and banishment framing where sacred authority is recognized.

name: Runefocus Rod
description: A crystal-inlaid channeling rod tuned to stabilize short arcane workings.
effects: Provides narrative grounding for controlled casting in unstable magical environments.

name: Lumen Charm
description: A palm-sized charm that emits steady witchlight when invoked.
effects: Provides reliable light and supports exploration in darkness without open flame.

name: Oathseal Ring
description: A signet that marks formal vows and is recognized by select civic orders.
effects: Supports binding-oath ceremony framing and social leverage where oath custom is honored.

name: The Heartwood Bow
description: The singular longbow crafted by Lethariel Heartwood from a Longbough limb offered by the Heartwood itself before the Discordant War — a living artifact carrying residual Heartwood connection.
effects: Unique artifact held exclusively by Lethariel Heartwood. Kept at Heartwood Estate between her active Heartwarden Captaincy rotations; returns to active service when Sylvara departs for her Proving.
Arrows loosed from the Heartwood Bow carry heightened accuracy and penetrating force in defense of the Heartwood and the Feywood.

The bow's Longbough material is Heartwood-offered and cannot pass to an unsanctioned bearer; attempts to use it by another party produce no magical effect and the bow's ambient-field register shifts in ways trained observers recognize.

name: Elven Welcome-Token
description: A small woven cord, bead, or carved disc given by an elven host to a sanctioned visitor — a relational artifact whose legitimacy comes from its provenance, not its form.
effects: The Feywood's ambient field registers the bearer as a welcome guest. Path-finding is subtly more cooperative; the Feywood's geometry favors the bearer's intended destinations.
Legitimacy derives from the specific act of giving by a recognized host — a stolen or forged token confers nothing, and attempts to forge one are recognizable to attuned elven observers.
Typically carried on the person (worn at the wrist, neck, or on a belt) for the duration of a visit; returned or kept as a memento when the visit concludes.

name: Heartlight Lantern
description: An elven lantern housing cultivated Hearthlight Fungus in a shaped crystal-and-wood frame — the standard Thornveil and Vaelmere evening light source, available in limited realm trade.
effects: Provides soft continuous bioluminescent light without fuel, flame, or smoke.
The fungus responds to ambient-field conditions: brightness subtly dims under Turning, cooperating with the Feywood's health register rather than masking it.
Lantern housing lasts indefinitely; the fungal colony requires periodic refreshment at Thornveil or from a trained elven keeper.

name: Veilvine Wayfinder
description: A small pendant of living Veilvine tended by its bearer — whose color shift indicates seasonal thresholds and ambient-field conditions in the Feywood and at the Border.
effects: Provides subtle visual reading of ambient-field state and seasonal transition timing — useful for druidic and ranger work.
Requires regular tending; neglected wayfinders wither within weeks.
Not a realm-trade item; given by druids or druidic-adjacent elves to practitioners who will actually tend it.

name: Rootlace Amulet
description: A small amulet containing living Rootlace Mycelium in a sealed chamber — given to druids and attuned elves to maintain a subtle continuous read of the Feywood's root-memory network.
effects: Supports attentional practice by providing a very subtle ambient-field signal the bearer learns to read over months of carry.
Not magical in a flashy sense; the effect is relational — a trained bearer notices the Feywood's state shifts slightly earlier than they otherwise would.
Cannot function outside the Feywood's immediate ambient-field reach; realm-side, the amulet's chamber goes dormant.

name: Oathbloom Ceremonial Vial
description: A sealed ceremonial vial of prepared Oathbloom infusion, made at a specific oath-marking event and intended for that occasion — a ceremonial artifact, not a commodity.
effects: Used only at the oath-marking event for which it was prepared. Consumption by the oathtaker and witnesses is part of the ceremony's structure.
Not sold; not stored speculatively; not exported under any circumstance.
A non-elf offered an Oathbloom infusion and accepting it is participating as a full party to the oath being sworn.

name: Briarmane Mane Braid
description: A small braided cord of Briarmane Courser mane hair — given by the mount to its bonded rider through shedding, then worked by the rider into a keepsake.
effects: A relational token between a bonded rider and a Briarmane Courser. Non-tradeable in the ordinary sense — separated from its rider, the braid carries no meaningful effect.
Recognized by other Briarmanes as a signal of the bearer's established relationship with a courser, affecting initial encounter behavior.
Common among Feywood riders and Silverbow rangers; rare realm-side except among Feywood-bonded individuals who have traveled outward.
